description: IDTA 02023 Carbon Footprint 1.0: removed TCF, ECLASS 15 IRDIs, PCF mandatory set, value lists (methods, units, lifecycle phases), spec misprints and PDF-vs-template-JSON differences.

items.question: What is the submodel semanticId of IDTA 02023 Carbon Footprint 1.0?
Our 0.9-based Carbon Footprint submodel has a TransportCarbonFootprint (TCF) block. Does it still exist in 1.0?
items.expected_answer: No. The Transport Carbon Footprint was removed in 1.0; only Product Carbon Footprints (plus the optional product/sector-specific PCFs) remain.

items.question: Which ECLASS release do the Carbon Footprint 1.0 IRDIs come from?
items.expected_answer: ECLASS 15 (updated from ECLASS 13 IRDIs in the 0.9 pre-release).

citation.quote: Update from ECLASS 13 IRDIs to ECLASS 15

items.question: What semanticId and valueType does PcfCO2eq have?

citation.section: 2.2.3, Table 4 SMC Product Carbon Footprint, row PcfCO2eq
citation.quote: PcfCO2eq [IRDI] 0173-1#02-ABG855#003 Sum of all greenhouse gas emissions of a product according to the quantification requirements of the standard. [decimal]

items.question: We put 'ISO 14067:2018' in PcfCalculationMethod. What value and valueId does the 1.0 value list give for ISO 14067?
items.expected_answer: Value "ISO 14067" with valueId 0173-1#07-ABU218#003 (value list 0173-1#09-AAO115#003); methods not in the table go into ProductOrSectorSpecificRule.

items.question: Which LifeCyclePhase value and valueId express a cradle-to-gate PCF?
Table 6 of IDTA 02023 1.0 gives the LifeCyclePhases list the semanticId .../PcfCalculationMethods/1/0. What should the LifeCyclePhases SML carry?
items.expected_answer: https://admin-shell.io/idta/CarbonFootprint/LifeCyclePhases/1/0, as printed in Table 4 (and in the official template); Table 6 repeats the PcfCalculationMethods IRI by mistake.

items.question: Is PublicationDate optional in a ProductCarbonFootprint, and which valueType does it have?
items.expected_answer: It is mandatory (cardinality 1) with valueType dateTime - the UTC timestamp when the PCF was created and published.

items.question: Is GoodsHandoverAddress mandatory in ProductCarbonFootprint according to the IDTA 02023 1.0 specification table, and does the official template file agree?
items.expected_answer: The specification (Table 4) prints cardinality 1, i.e. mandatory; the official 1.0 and 1.0.1 template JSON qualify it as ZeroToOne (0..1). The two official artefacts disagree.

citation.quote: indicates the hand-over address of the goods transport. Note: this set of information is defined by SMT drop-in "Address Information" n/a 1

items.notes: Template JSON 1.0.1: GoodsHandoverAddress SMT/Cardinality = ZeroToOne (lines 470-529 of IDTA 02023-1-0-1 _Template_CarbonFootprint.json).

items.question: Which valueType does PcfApiEndpoint (ExternalPcfApi) have in the official Carbon Footprint template?
items.expected_answer: xs:anyURI in the official 1.0.1 template JSON (the PDF table prints [string]).

citation.document: IDTA 02023 Carbon Footprint - official template JSON

items.question: We have PCFs per ISO 14067 and per GHG Protocol for different lifecycle scopes. One ProductCarbonFootprint or several?
items.expected_answer: Several: if multiple calculation methods or lifecycle phases are supplied, multiple ProductCarbonFootprint SMC instances shall be instantiated in the ProductCarbonFootprints list.

citation.quote: If multiple calculation methods or lifecycle phases are to be supplied with the Submodel template, multiple instances of this SMC shall be instantiated.

items.question: Which value and valueId should ReferenceImpactUnitForCalculation use when the PCF refers to one piece?
What semanticId does the arbitrary content element in PcfInformation use - a CarbonFootprint IRI?
items.expected_answer: No: https://admin-shell.io/SMT/General/Arbitrary (cardinality 0..n). The 1.0 PDF misspells the idShort as ArbitratyContent; the template uses ArbitraryContent.

items.question: Is PcfRuleOnlineReference in ProductOrSectorSpecificRule a Property holding a URL?
items.expected_answer: No. It is a File element (0..1), semanticId https://admin-shell.io/idta/CarbonFootprint/ProductOrSectorSpecificRule/OnlineReference/1/0.

items.question: A LifeCyclePhases entry holds the value 'A3 - production'. Is that a valid value of the IDTA-02023 LifeCyclePhase value list, or must it be the bare code 'A3'?
items.expected_answer: It is valid. Table 13 lists the value as the label string 'A3 - production' (valueId 0173-1#07-ABU210#003); only the ranges such as A1-A3 are bare codes. A checker must not flag the label.
